items.statement: The presidential administration publishes a register of all pardon proposals granted and decrees issued since 23 January 2017. Its header states that it is kept under the Rules of the Pardon Commission approved by Decree No. 78 of 3 February 2017 and by Decree No. 38 of 2022 - i.e. the commission's legal basis is presidential decree, not statute.
items.quote: РЕГИСТЪР НА НАПРАВЕНИТЕ ПРЕДЛОЖЕНИЯ И ИЗДАДЕНИТЕ УКАЗИ ЗА ПОМИЛВАНЕ след 23 януари 2017 г. На основание чл. 7 (6) от Правилата за работа на Комисията по помилване към президента на Републиката, утвърдени с Указ № 78/03.02. 2017 г., и чл. 9 (6) от Правилата, утвърдени с Указ № 38 от 2022 г.
items.source: President of the Republic of Bulgaria - "Регистър на направените предложения и издадените укази за помилване след 23 януари 2017 г." (Word document, presidency website)

items.statement: Entry 23 of the register is the Atanasov pardon. It records a 59-year-old Bulgarian sentenced in 2019 by the Thessaloniki Court of Appeal for acts committed in 1999-2000, qualified under art. 321(3)(1) of the Bulgarian Criminal Code (participation in an organised criminal group) - import, trafficking and sale of drugs in Greece - to 15 years, of which he had served five. It says the expert medical commission found extremely serious illnesses, that his sentence had already been suspended for two years on health grounds, and that he was pardoned for the remainder by Decree No. 119 of 5 December 2022. The entry does not name him.
items.quote: Деянията са квалифицирани по чл. 321, ал. 3, т. 1 НК – внос, трафик и продажба на наркотици в Гърция и е осъден на 15 г. лишаване от свобода, от които е изтърпял 5 години. […] Същият е в прекъсване на изтърпяването на наказанието от две години. […] Помилван е с остатъка от наказанието с Указ № 119 от 5 декември 2022 г.
items.source: President of the Republic of Bulgaria - register of pardons, entry 23

items.statement: The presidency's own account: Iotova referred the Atanasov case to the prosecution on 19 October 2026 and sent the entire file. An internal review found the documents were present and the Pardon Commission followed its rules. The medical opinion came from "the medical commission under art. 138 of the Execution of Penal Sanctions and Detention in Custody Act" and was given after the prisoner appeared before it in person. The file contained 7 prosecutor's orders suspending execution of the sentence, 13 medical expert reports, 3 TELK (disability) expert decisions, test results and outpatient records. It also says 14 access-to-information requests were answered between 11 September and 21 October, and rejects as false the suggestion that the Pardon Commission sat in an unlawful composition in Nov 2017-Jan 2018.
items.quote: Държавният глава Илияна Йотова е сезирала на 19 октомври прокуратурата във връзка с помилването на Огнян Атанасов и е изпратила цялата преписка по случая […] Предоставено е експертно становище на медицинската комисия по чл. 138 от Закона за изпълнение на наказанията и задържането под стража.
items.source: БТА - "Президентът Йотова е сезирала прокуратурата по отношение помилването на Огнян Атанасов, вътрешна проверка не е установила нарушения" (reproduces the presidential press service statement verbatim)

items.statement: The presidency's first public defence (11 September 2026, when the scandal broke): the register on its website contains publicly available information about the case but omits the pardoned person's name under personal-data law; under the State Gazette Act pardon decrees are not published in the State Gazette at all. It adds that the pardon decision is taken on a proposal of the Pardon Commission, and that at the time of the 2022 pardon Atanasov's sentence had already been suspended for two years because of his deteriorated health.
items.quote: От президентската институция уточняват, че на нейния сайт, в Регистъра на помилваните лица, се съдържа общодостъпна информация по случая, без да бъде споменато името на помилваното лице съгласно Закона за защита на личните данни. А в Закона за "Държавен вестник" е записано, че указите за помилване не се публикуват в него.
items.source: БНР (Хоризонт) - "Президентството отговори на обвиненията за помилван от Йотова наркопласьор"

items.statement: On the Pardon Commission's membership, the presidency answered an access-to-information request with pseudonymised initials only: the chair is L.P.R. and the members are Yu.D.B., I.D.B., V.Y.K. and M.M.G. The same information (full decrees appointing and dismissing members) had been given to Sega four days earlier but is not published on the presidency site. Capital notes that nobody has seen the Pardon Commission's or the medical commission's opinions on the Atanasov case.
items.quote: Комисията по помилването към президента в момента се председателства от Л.П.Р, а другите нейни членове са Ю.Д.Б., И.Д.Б., В.Й.К. и М.М.Г.
items.source: Капитал - "Президентът И.М.Й. се консултира за помилванията с Л.П.Р, Ю.Д.Б., И.Д.Б., В.Й.К. и М.М.Г."

items.statement: Capital distinguishes the two bodies: the Pardon Commission is only an advisory expert body that does not take the final decision, exists by presidential decree rather than statute, and its opinions have never been published; the medical commission under art. 138 of the Execution of Penal Sanctions Act is a standing body that gives opinions on all prisoners, was appointed in July 2022 (i.e. before Atanasov's application), and its opinion is not binding on the president.
items.quote: Медицинската комисия по чл. 138 от Закона за изпълнението на наказанията и задържането под стража се назначава, за да дава становища и заключения за всички затворници и арестанти в системата. И разбира се, нейното становище не е задължително
items.source: Капитал - "Президентът И.М.Й. се консултира за помилванията с Л.П.Р, Ю.Д.Б., И.Д.Б., В.Й.К. и М.М.Г."

items.statement: Sega sets out the medical commission's legal basis and composition: under the Execution of Penal Sanctions and Detention in Custody Act there is a 7-member commission with a 3-year mandate at the General Directorate "Execution of Penalties", giving opinions on all prisoners and detainees, appointed by the justice minister in coordination with the health minister. It reports MP Petar Vitanov's account of who the seven are: five doctors from prison hospitals, one chief expert from the Ministry of Health and one doctor from the leadership of the National Centre for Training and Qualification in Emergency Medical Care, appointed in 2022 by minister Nadezhda Yordanova. It stresses that this commission only assesses health and cannot propose a pardon.
items.quote: По Закона за изпълнение на наказанията и задържането под стража (ЗИНЗС) към Главна дирекция "Изпълнение на наказанията" има 7-членна комисия с 3-годишен мандат, която дава становище и заключения за всички затворници и арестанти. Тя се назначава от министъра на правосъдието, съгласувано с министъра на здравеопазването.
items.source: Сега - "Излязоха още скандални факти за помилването на Петричкия Ескобар"

items.statement: The central contested claim, made by Nadezhda Yordanova (Yes, Bulgaria) the day after the debate: the medical commission did not propose the pardon; the proposal came from the Pardon Commission appointed by a decree of President Radev; and she holds official medical-commission documents that refute the claim that Atanasov was in a wheelchair before the pardon. This is a party position, not a document.
items.quote: Първо, медицинската комисия, отговорна за състоянието на лишените от свобода, не е предлагала помилването на Огнян Атанасов. Второ, това предложение е направено от Комисията по помилванията, назначена с указ от президента Румен Радев.
items.source: OFFNews - "Надежда Йорданова: Йотова отново излъга за помилването на Петричкия Ескобар" (DB press statement)

items.statement: The debate exchange (29 October 2026, BNT): Gyurov asked Iotova to apologise to Bulgarian mothers for pardoning drug traffickers (plural) and said she bears full responsibility for the signature. Iotova replied that his whole campaign was built on lies and that he must not know the pardon procedure, said she had given the prosecution all the documents signed by her, named the then justice and health ministers (Yordanova and Serbezova) as having appointed the medical commission, and said her decision was taken entirely on humanitarian and medical grounds. The same article recalls that Atanasov's sentence was cut by nearly 10 years and that he was detained again in 2025 with 5 kg of cocaine.
items.quote: Изградихте цялата си кампания върху лъжи. Трябва да не познавате процедурите на помилванията, за да твърдите такова нещо […] Решението ми изцяло е взето по хуманитарни и медицински причини
items.source: Actualno.com - ""Решенията ми бяха по хуманитарни и медицински причини": Йотова защити помилванията пред Гюров и отказа да се извини"

items.statement: The "repeated pardons of drug traffickers" claim, quantified: Sega counted 28 pardons over the two Radev-Iotova terms and found that six were of people convicted of drug-related offences, although Iotova had said at her first Pardon Commission meeting that she would never pardon a drug convict. Sega also records that the register has become progressively thinner and that the names of the Pardon Commission members were withheld.
items.quote: 28 са помилваните по време на двата президентски мандата на Румен Радев и Илияна Йотова. […] И макар да се е заричала, че никога няма да помилва осъден за наркотици, 6 пъти Йотова е издавала указ за хора, осъдени за престъпления, свързани с дрога.
items.source: Сега - "Шестима са осъдените за наркотици, помилвани от Йотова"

items.statement: The second pardon that became a campaign issue: a 52-year-old man sentenced to 4 years 4 months under art. 343a(1) (fatal road accident), art. 321(3) (organised criminal group) and art. 354a(2) (large-quantity drug offence), pardoned on health grounds by Decree No. 1 of 6 February 2025. Sega used a register version in which this was entry 27 (in the current register it is entry 28). The entry gives no reasoning beyond "extremely serious health condition"; the identification of the pardoned man (initials D.S.G. per the NGO BG Elves; the "Dinko Ludia" case per later Sega reporting) is inference, not an official identification.
items.quote: молителят е 52-годишен български гражданин със средно образование, осъден по чл. 343а, ал. 1, 321, ал. 3 и 354а, ал. 2 на 4 г. 4 м. лишаване от свобода. Молителят е в изключително тежко здравословно състояние, установено с необходимите документи. Помилван е по здравословни причини с Указ 1/6 февруари 2025 г.
items.source: Сега - "Още едно помилване на Йотова на наркодилър събуди подозрения"

items.statement: The Pardon Commission's constitutional and institutional setting, from the presidency's published rules (the version approved by Decree No. 80 of 23 February 2012, still posted on the site): it is an auxiliary expert advisory body to the President, or to the Vice-President when the pardon function is assigned to her - the legal route by which Iotova signed decrees as vice-president - and it assists in exercising the pardon power under art. 98(11) of the Constitution. The rules set a 4/5 attendance quorum and a public report every three months.
items.quote: Комисията по помилването е помощен експертен съвещателен орган при Президента, съответно при Вицепрезидента, когато на него е възложена функцията по помилване. […] Подпомага осъществяването на функцията по помилването по чл. 98, т. 11 от Конституцията на Република България
items.source: President of the Republic of Bulgaria - "Правила за работа на новоучредената Комисия по помилване към президента"

open_questions: Which prosecution office received the file on 19 October 2026, and whether a check (проверка) or a pre-trial proceeding was opened, could not be established: the presidency said only 'the prosecution service'; Sega reported on 30 October that ten days later it was still unknown whether a check or a case had been opened and which prosecution was handling it. No later reporting was found up to 31 October.

The names of the seven medical-commission members were not verified from a primary document. Vitanov's disclosure is known only through Sega's description (five prison-hospital doctors, one Health Ministry chief expert, one emergency-medicine doctor); the Dnevnik article that named them returned HTTP 403 (Cloudflare) and could not be fetched.

The text of art. 138 of the Execution of Penal Sanctions and Detention in Custody Act was not retrieved directly: lex.bg returned an error page and the available PDFs were not text-extractable here. The 7-member / 3-year-mandate / appointment-by-justice-minister-in-coordination-with-health-minister description rests on secondary reporting (Sega) plus the presidency's citation of art. 138.

Whether the February 2025 pardon (Decree No. 1/6.02.2025) is the case nicknamed 'Dinko Ludia' is an inference from Sega's own sequencing and is not confirmed by an official document; the register does not name pardoned persons.

The exact number of pardons: Sega counted 28 (21 October); the current register lists 30 granted proposals (the last being Decree No. 105 of 12 March 2026). The discrepancy is consistent with the register having been updated after Sega's count, but I did not obtain the earlier snapshot of the register that Sega used to confirm the numbering shift (Feb 2025 case: No. 27 then, No. 28 now).

Iotova's 2017 statement that she would 'never pardon a drug convict' is known from Sega's description of video from the first Pardon Commission meeting; the video itself and a verbatim transcript were not obtained, so the wording should be treated as Sega's rendering.
No official aggregate statistics (applications received, granted, refused by year) were retrieved; the register covers only granted proposals and a short list of refused ones.
Whether any decree formally assigns the pardon function to the vice-president (the basis on which Iotova signed in 2022) was not found; only the rules' general clause allowing it was verified.
The claim that the Pardon Commission sat unlawfully / without quorum and handled 110 files (Sega) is denied by the presidency; no court or prosecutorial finding on it was found.
notes: The cluster has a solid documentary core and a contested interpretative layer. What is documented: the pardon itself (Decree No. 119 of 5 Dec 2022, 15-year Thessaloniki sentence for drug trafficking, five years served, remainder remitted on health grounds), the identity of the two commissions and their different legal bases (the Pardon Commission is a decree-based advisory body under art. 98(11) of the Constitution; the medical commission is the art. 138 standing body of the prison system), the fact that the file was sent to the prosecution on 19 October 2026 with a documented inventory (7 suspension orders, 13 medical reports, 3 TELK decisions), and the fact that the pardon documents are only published in anonymised, motive-free summary form while the decrees are not gazetted at all. The count behind Gyurov's debate attack - six drug-related pardons - is independently checkable in the register, which now lists 30 granted pardons, six of them drug-related (entries 9, 11, 16, 22, 23 and 28). What is merely asserted: the dispute over whether the medical commission 'recommended' the pardon or only assessed health, whether Atanasov was mobilised or in a wheelchair, and whether the commission was unlawfully composed - these are party claims traded by DB and Progressive Bulgaria, with the presidency denying wrongdoing and no independent (prosecutorial, judicial or medical) finding yet. Reliability is therefore high on the paper trail and low on the motive/medical questions, and the cluster should be presented as 'documented procedure, contested interpretation'.
